quotes.text: My wife and I booked a flight out the Grand Canyom, with a return to Las Vegas around sunset, with GC Flight. From the moment we booked the excursion we were impressed with the reservation process and our pilot, Tucker. From the time we were picked up at our hotel the waiting time at the terminal was minimal, and we were off in no time! Tucker flew us out to Lake Mead, past Hoover Dam, and to our inner canyon landing site. Once on the ground, we explored the site, sipped Champaign, and were off for Vegas. We cannot thank Tucker and GC Flight for a memorable experience.i read moreread less

quotes.author: Christina Arobieke
quotes.text: The entire experience was seamless! From booking, to shuttle pick up, meeting the pilot and fellow passengers, landing etc. The service exceptional, the staff professional and friendly. The pilot made us feel safe and well looked after, I thoroughly enjoyed the experience and hope to fly with them again in future. My friend and I did the red rock canyon tour within Vegas, if you want a longer and more breath taking experience, which maybe a little more expensive, I'd say do the grand canyon. read moreread less Christina Arobieke

quotes.author: Angerra King-Hardy
quotes.text: My husband and I chose the sunset extended tour for our anniversary and I'm so happy that we had this experience. The pilot, Manny, was so nice and his jokes were funny. Manny was great with providing us with facts about the areas we were passing and making sure we were all ok. The gentleman who picked up and dropped us back off at the hotel was prompt and the van was super clean; this was a plus. I would 100% recommend GC Flight and do another tour the next time I'm in LV. read moreread less Angerra King-Hardy

quotes.author: HYDRILLA GEAR
quotes.text: GC was extremely accommodating and the flight to the bottom of the Grand Canyon was simply amazing! Pictures do not do this experience justice. In my opinion it’s a must in life. Our Pilot was an ex military helicopter pilot. He made us feel safe and we had a smooth flight throughout the entire tour. He narrated during the trip which was great and informative. GC FLIGHT is doing it right! Thank you GC and it’s staff for such a memorable trip! read moreread less HYDRILLA GEAR

quotes.author: Joel Carpenter
quotes.text: Our pilot, Tannan, was awesome! He was professional, knowledgeable and really made our experience one we will never forget. We did the rim landing tour in the afternoon on Halloween - which I would highly recommend. Next time you are in Las Vegas a GC Flight tour should be on your agenda. Everything from booking (I worked over the phone with Leslie who was also spectacular) to the hotel pickup and drop off were top notch. read moreread less Joel Carpenter

quotes.author: Gina Collins
quotes.text: This was my first time to see the Grand Canyon and ride in a Helicopter. Our pilot was very knowledgeable and informative of what we were seeing. The flight was smooth and we had a wonderful time. Well worth the money and I highly recommend this company! We were able to purchase a digital photo frame after we got back that also had a video on it. This is something everyone should do at least once in their life! read moreread less Gina Collins
